tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: Lists all Lightning Networks in Polar with their configurations and status

tools.name: create_network
tools.description: Creates a new Lightning Network in Polar with the specified node implementations and versions. Use the list_node_versions tool to see supported versions. Nodes that omit a version will use the latest available.

nodes.description: List of nodes to include in the new network. Each entry may specify a version and count (defaults to 1).

implementation.description: Node implementation to add to the network

version.description: Version of the implementation to use (optional). Latest version is used when omitted.

count.description: Number of nodes of this type to create (default: 1)

tools.name: import_network_from_zip
tools.description: Imports a Lightning Network from a .polar.zip file that was previously exported from Polar. The zip file must exist at the specified path. Returns the imported network summary.

path.description: Absolute path to the .polar.zip file to import

tools.name: export_network_to_zip
tools.description: Exports a Lightning Network to a .polar.zip file. The network must be in Stopped or Error status. The exported file can be imported back into Polar using the import_network_from_zip tool.

networkId.description: ID of the network to export

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the .polar.zip file will be saved

tools.name: start_network
tools.description: Starts a Lightning Network in Polar. This will start all Bitcoin and Lightning nodes in the specified network.

networkId.description: ID of the network to start

tools.name: stop_network
tools.description: Stops a Lightning Network in Polar. This will gracefully shut down all Bitcoin and Lightning nodes in the specified network.

networkId.description: ID of the network to stop

tools.name: delete_network
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Lightning Network in Polar. This will remove all nodes, channels, and data associated with the network. This action cannot be undone.

networkId.description: ID of the network to delete

tools.name: rename_network
tools.description: Renames a Lightning Network in Polar and optionally updates its description. The name is used for identification and must be unique among networks.

networkId.description: ID of the network to rename

description.description: Optional new description for the network

tools.name: set_lightning_backend
tools.description: Changes the Bitcoin backend node for a Lightning Network node. This reassigns which Bitcoin node the Lightning node will connect to as its backend. If the network is running, the Lightning node will be restarted to apply the change.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the nodes

lightningNodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node whose backend should be changed

bitcoinNodeName.description: Name of the Bitcoin node to set as the backend

tools.name: set_tap_backend
tools.description: Changes the LND backend node for a Taproot Assets (TAP) node. This reassigns which LND node the TAP node will connect to as its backend.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the nodes

tapNodeName.description: Name of the TAP node whose backend should be changed

lndNodeName.description: Name of the LND node to set as the backend

tools.name: update_node_command
tools.description: Updates the custom docker command for a node in a network. This allows customization of node startup parameters. The command will be used instead of the default command for the node implementation. Leave command empty to reset to the default.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the node

nodeName.description: Name of the node whose command should be updated

command.description: The docker command to use for the node. Empty string resets to default.

tools.name: get_default_node_command
tools.description: Returns the default docker command for a given node implementation and version. The command includes placeholders like {{name}}, {{backendName}}, etc. that get replaced with actual values when the node starts. If version is not provided, the latest version will be used.

implementation.description: The node implementation to get the default command for

version.description: Optional version of the implementation. Uses latest if not specified.

tools.name: list_node_versions
tools.description: Lists all supported versions for node implementations included in Polar and the compatibility requirements for each version. The compatibility requirements are a map of version to the minimum version that is compatible with it.

implementation.description: Filter to show versions for a specific implementation only (optional)

tools.name: add_node
tools.description: Adds a Bitcoin Core or Lightning Network node to an existing Polar network. Supports Bitcoin Core (bitcoind), LND, c-lightning, eclair, and litd (Lightning Terminal) implementations. If the network is started, the node will be automatically started as well.

networkId.description: ID of the network to add the node to

version.description: Version of the implementation (optional, uses latest if not specified). Use the list_node_versions tool to see supported versions.

tools.name: start_node
tools.description: Starts a specific node in a Polar network. The node must be in Stopped or Error state. Supports Bitcoin Core, Lightning Network, and Taproot Assets daemon nodes.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the node

nodeName.description: Name of the node to start

tools.name: restart_node
tools.description: Restarts a specific node in a Polar network. The node must be in Started or Error state. This operation stops the node first, then starts it again. Supports Bitcoin Core, Lightning Network, and Taproot Assets daemon nodes.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the node

nodeName.description: Name of the node to restart

tools.name: stop_node
tools.description: Stops a specific node in a Polar network. The node must be in Started state. Supports Bitcoin Core, Lightning Network, and Taproot Assets daemon nodes.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the node

nodeName.description: Name of the node to stop

tools.name: remove_node
tools.description: Removes a node from an existing Polar network. This will permanently delete the node and all its data. Supports removing Lightning nodes (LND, c-lightning, eclair, litd), Bitcoin nodes (bitcoind), and Taproot Asset nodes (tapd). If the network is running, the node will be stopped before removal.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the node to remove

nodeName.description: Name of the node to remove from the network

tools.name: rename_node
tools.description: Renames a node in an existing Polar network. This will update the node name throughout the system, including Docker containers, configuration files, and UI references. Supports renaming Lightning nodes (LND, c-lightning, eclair, litd), Bitcoin nodes (bitcoind), and Taproot Asset nodes (tapd). If the network is running, it will be temporarily stopped during the rename operation.

networkId.description: ID of the network containing the node to rename

oldName.description: Current name of the node to rename

tools.name: mine_blocks
tools.description: Mine Bitcoin blocks in a Polar network. This generates new blocks on the Bitcoin blockchain, which is necessary for confirming transactions and advancing the chain.

nodeName.description: Name of the Bitcoin node to mine with (optional, uses first node if not specified)

tools.name: get_blockchain_info
tools.description: Get blockchain information from a Bitcoin node in a Polar network. Returns current block height, chain name, difficulty, and other blockchain state.

nodeName.description: Name of the Bitcoin node to query (optional, uses first node if not specified)

tools.name: get_bitcoin_wallet_info
tools.description: Get wallet information from a Bitcoin node including the total balance and transaction count. Returns the current wallet balance in BTC and the total number of transactions in the wallet.

nodeName.description: Name of the Bitcoin node to query (optional, uses first node if not specified)

tools.name: send_bitcoin
tools.description: Send on-chain Bitcoin transaction from a Bitcoin node to an address, optionally mining blocks to confirm the transaction.

fromNode.description: Name of the node sending the Bitcoin

amount.description: Amount of Bitcoin to send (in bitcoin, so 0.00000001 is 1 satoshi)

autoMine.description: Whether to automatically mine 6 blocks to confirm the transaction (default: false)

tools.name: get_new_bitcoin_address
tools.description: Generate new Bitcoin address for Lightning/Bitcoin nodes. This creates a new receiving address that can be used to receive on-chain Bitcoin payments.

nodeName.description: Name of the node to generate address for (optional, uses first available node if not specified)

tools.name: set_auto_mine_mode
tools.description: Set the auto-mining mode for a Polar network. Auto-mining automatically generates new blocks at regular intervals, which is useful for testing Lightning Network functionality.

tools.name: open_channel
tools.description: Open a Lightning Network channel between two nodes in a Polar network. This creates a payment channel with the specified capacity. You can optionally set the channel as private and auto-fund the source node if it lacks sufficient balance.

fromNode.description: Name of the source Lightning node (the one funding the channel)

toNode.description: Name of the destination Lightning node

isPrivate.description: Whether the channel should be private (not announced to the network). Default: false

autoFund.description: Automatically deposit funds to the source node if it lacks sufficient balance. Default: true

tools.name: close_channel
tools.description: Close a Lightning Network channel in a Polar network. This cooperatively closes the specified channel and returns the funds to the on-chain wallet.

nodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node that has the channel

channelPoint.description: Channel point identifier in the format "txid:output_index" (e.g., "abc123...def:0")

tools.name: close_tap_channel
tools.description: Close a Taproot Asset-enabled Lightning Network channel in a Polar network. This cooperatively closes the specified asset-enabled channel and returns the locked Taproot Assets to the on-chain wallet. Works with litd nodes only.

nodeName.description: Name of the litd node that has the channel

channelPoint.description: Channel point identifier in the format "txid:output_index" (e.g., "abc123...def:0")

tools.name: fund_tap_channel
tools.description: Fund a Lightning Network channel with Taproot Assets between two litd nodes. This creates an asset-enabled payment channel using the specified asset as collateral. The asset must exist on the source node and will be locked in the channel. Works with litd nodes only (which include integrated LND + tapd).

fromNode.description: Name of the source litd node (the one holding the asset)

toNode.description: Name of the destination litd node

assetId.description: Asset ID of the Taproot Asset to use for funding

amount.description: Amount of the asset to fund the channel with

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List all Lightning Network channels for a specific node, including both channels initiated by the node and channels where the node is the peer. Returns information about each channel including status, balances, capacity, and whether the channel is pending, open, or closed. This is useful for checking channel connectivity and balance distribution.

nodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node to list channels for

tools.name: get_node_info
tools.description: Get information about a Lightning node including its public key, alias, sync status, block height, and channel counts. This provides essential node information for monitoring and debugging Lightning Network operations.

nodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node to get info for

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Get the on-chain wallet balance for a Lightning node (LND, c-lightning, eclair, or litd). Returns the total, confirmed, and unconfirmed balances in satoshis. This shows the funds available in the node's on-chain Bitcoin wallet that can be used to open channels or for on-chain transactions. Note: This does not return channel balances - use list_channels to see balances within Lightning channels.

nodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node to get balance for

tools.name: deposit_funds
tools.description: Deposit Bitcoin from the network to a Lightning node on-chain wallet. This sends funds from the Bitcoin Core node to the Lightning node, then mines blocks to confirm the transaction. The deposited funds will be available in the Lightning node wallet for opening channels or on-chain transactions. Works with LND, c-lightning, eclair, and litd nodes.

nodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node to deposit funds to

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a Lightning Network payment invoice for a node. Generates a payment request string (BOLT11 invoice) that can be paid by other Lightning nodes. The invoice contains the payment amount and an optional memo. Returns the payment request string that can be used with pay_invoice. Works with LND, c-lightning, eclair, and litd nodes.

nodeName.description: Name of the Lightning node to create invoice on

amount.description: Amount in satoshis for the invoice

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description: Pay a Lightning Network payment invoice from a specific node. The invoice is a BOLT11 payment request string. An optional amount can be provided for invoices without a specific amount. Returns a payment receipt with the preimage and fees paid. Works with LND, c-lightning, eclair, and litd nodes.

fromNode.description: Name of the Lightning node to pay the invoice from

invoice.description: The BOLT11 payment request string to pay

amount.description: Optional amount in satoshis to pay for an invoice without a specified amount

tools.name: mint_tap_asset
tools.description: Mint a new Taproot Asset on a tapd or litd node. Creates a new asset with the specified parameters. For normal assets, you can specify an amount and decimals. For collectibles, the amount is always 1. Set finalize=true to automatically finalize the batch and mine blocks to confirm. Set autoFund=true to automatically fund the node with Bitcoin if needed. Works with tapd nodes and litd nodes (which include integrated tapd).

nodeName.description: Name of the tapd or litd node to mint the asset on

assetType.description: Type of asset: "normal" for fungible assets, "collectible" for NFTs

amount.description: Amount to mint (ignored for collectibles, which are always 1)

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for the asset (default: 0, max: 8). Only for normal assets. The amount must be the total number of units in the supply, so 10000 amount with 2 decimals would be displayed as 100.00

enableEmission.description: Whether to enable future emission for this asset (creates an asset group)

finalize.description: Whether to finalize the batch immediately and mine blocks to confirm

autoFund.description: Whether to automatically fund the LND node with Bitcoin if needed

tools.name: list_tap_assets
tools.description: List all Taproot Assets for a specific tapd or litd node. Returns asset details including ID, name, type, amount, genesis point, and decimals. Works with tapd nodes and litd nodes (which include integrated tapd).

nodeName.description: Name of the tapd or litd node to list assets from

tools.name: send_tap_asset
tools.description: Send a Taproot Asset from a tapd or litd node to a given address. Set autoFund=true to automatically fund the node with Bitcoin if needed. Works with tapd nodes and litd nodes (which include integrated tapd).

fromNode.description: Name of the tapd or litd node to send the asset from

address.description: The Taproot Asset address to send to

autoFund.description: Whether to automatically fund the LND node with Bitcoin if needed

tools.name: get_tap_balances
tools.description: Get all Taproot Asset balances for a specific tapd or litd node. Returns a list of assets with their balances. Works with tapd nodes and litd nodes (which include integrated tapd).

nodeName.description: Name of the tapd or litd node to get balances from

tools.name: get_tap_address
tools.description: Generate Taproot Asset address

nodeName.description: Name of the tapd or litd node

assetId.description: The asset ID to create an address for

amount.description: The amount of the asset to send

tools.name: decode_tap_address
tools.description: Decode Taproot Asset address

nodeName.description: Name of the tapd or litd node

address.description: The Taproot Asset address to decode

tools.name: sync_tap_universe
tools.description: Sync with Taproot Assets universe

nodeName.description: Name of the tapd or litd node

universeNodeName.description: The name of the tapd node to sync with

tools.name: create_asset_invoice
tools.description: Create a Lightning invoice payable with Taproot Assets from a litd node. The node must have sufficient assets in channels to create the invoice. Works only with litd nodes (which include integrated LND + Lightning Terminal + tapd).

nodeName.description: Name of the litd node to create the invoice from

assetId.description: ID of the Taproot Asset to create invoice for

amount.description: Amount of the asset to invoice for

tools.name: pay_asset_invoice
tools.description: Pay a Lightning invoice using Taproot Assets from a litd node. The node must have sufficient assets in channels to pay the invoice. Works only with litd nodes (which include integrated LND + Lightning Terminal + tapd).

fromNode.description: Name of the litd node to pay the invoice from

assetId.description: ID of the Taproot Asset to use for payment

invoice.description: The Lightning invoice string to pay

tools.name: get_assets_in_channels
tools.description: Get all Taproot Assets available in Lightning channels for a litd node. Returns assets with their balances and peer information. Works only with litd nodes (which include integrated LND + Lightning Terminal + tapd).

nodeName.description: Name of the litd node to get assets in channels for

tools.name: list_litd_sessions
tools.description: List all Lightning Node Connect (LNC) sessions for a litd node. This provides information about active sessions including labels, states, pairing phrases, and expiration times. Useful for managing remote Lightning node connections.

nodeName.description: Name of the litd node to list sessions for

tools.name: add_litd_session
tools.description: Create a new Lightning Node Connect (LNC) session for a litd node. This generates a pairing phrase that can be used to connect remote applications to the Lightning node. Sessions can be admin (full access), read_only (view only), or custom (specific permissions).

nodeName.description: Name of the litd node to create session for

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp when the session expires (in seconds). Defaults to 90 days from now if not provided.

mailboxServerAddr.description: Optional mailbox server address for the session (defaults to mailbox.terminal.lightning.today:443)

tools.name: revoke_litd_session
tools.description: Revoke an existing Lightning Node Connect (LNC) session for a litd node. This permanently disables the session and invalidates its pairing phrase. The session will no longer be usable for remote connections.

nodeName.description: Name of the litd node to revoke session for

localPublicKey.description: Local public key of the session to revoke
